description: This file defines the LimitsConfig interface which provides configuration settings related to various size limits and pagination defaults for Ditto services. It includes nested enumeration LimitsConfigValue that defines specific configuration keys and their default values, along with associated constants.

classes.name: LimitsConfig
classes.description: An interface that declares methods to retrieve limits and size constraints for the Ditto services.

classes.name: LimitsConfig.LimitsConfigValue
classes.description: An enum specifying known configuration path expressions and default values for LimitsConfig, implementing KnownConfigValue.

classes.name: LimitsConfig.LimitsConfigValue.Constants
classes.description: A static nested class defining default constant values and shared path segments for LimitsConfigValue.

methods.name: getHeadersMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size allowed for headers in bytes.

methods.name: getAuthSubjectsMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of authorization subjects permitted in headers.

methods.name: getThingsMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for 'Thing' entities in bytes.

methods.name: getPoliciesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for 'Policies' entities in bytes.

methods.name: getMessagesMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for 'Messages' entities in bytes.

methods.name: getThingsSearchDefaultPageSize
methods.description: Returns the default pagination size when searching for 'Things'.

methods.name: getThingsSearchMaxPageSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum pagination size for 'Things' search.
